title: AI provider layer (api): shared-ai-key flag, own keys, 5 provider adapters, model listing
description: New feature api/src/ai/. Feature 'shared-ai-key' (default off) in shared/src/features. Table ai_credentials (user, provider, sealed secret, chosen model) via core/secret-box, copying api/src/connections/keys.ts and migration 0104. Own keys are stored on the server for every platform. Resolution: own key wins, else shared env key when the flag is on, else error own_ai_key_required; no paused state. AiProvider interface (chat with tool calls + structured output, list models) with adapters for OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI, Z.ai, DeepSeek. Detect provider from the key format, caller may override. Shared key: provider/model from env + app_settings. Contracts in shared/src/contracts/ai/: credentials status, save, delete, test, detect provider, list models. Plan, decisions and owner answers: handoff.md at the repo root. Mock: tk show budget-seoa (evidence ev-c96ced overview, PNGs). Follow AGENTS.md (contracts, migrations additive only + MIGRATION_SIGNATURES, i18n, ports, test DB rules).
